title: Commissions
description: Follow each placement from hire to payout. Amounts are estimates until the client pays. Shares become owed once that payment is confirmed. Shares can be paid outside MissionHub and recorded here, or through MissionHub where online payments are available.

kpi.projectedHint: Hires not yet paid by client

otherCurrencies: Totals include only {currency} placements; other currencies are listed below and never converted.

empty.title: No placements yet
empty.description: When a referral ends in a hire, the placement and who is owed what will appear here.

detail.flashCreated: Placement created from the frozen agreement. Next: record the client invoice.
detail.subtitle: {candidate} · starts {start}
detail.platformVerifies: Verified by a MissionHub platform administrator.
detail.ledgerEmpty: Empty until a client payment is verified. Entries are immutable; corrections are recorded as reversing entries.
detail.payThroughHint: Pays the sourcing recruiter and the platform share in one step. No payout evidence needed.
detail.paymentReturned: Thanks. Your payment is being confirmed; this page updates when the provider confirms it.

forms.invoiceDescription: The invoice you (the job owner) issued to the hiring company. Amounts in {currency}.
forms.evidenceDescription: Recorded as pending. It changes the ledger only after someone other than you verifies it against the bank record.
forms.verifyDescription: Only verify after checking the actual bank or payment record. Verification writes immutable ledger entries.
forms.rejectDescription: The recorder will need to submit corrected evidence.
forms.disputeDescription: The placement is frozen (no new evidence or verification) until a platform administrator resolves it. History is never deleted.

messages.evidenceRecorded: Evidence recorded. It affects the ledger only after independent verification.
messages.disputeOpened: Dispute opened. The placement is frozen pending platform review.

validation.rejectReason: Give a reason for the rejection.
